### Bugs Found: 1

#### [BUG-01] `viewer` role does not exist in the platform

- **Category:** Invalid Role
- **Severity:** Medium — The role `viewer` is referenced in swarm instructions but is **not defined** in the platform's role system
- **Platform's actual roles:** `user`, `it`, `superuser`, `admin`, `it_admin`, `it_manager`
- **Impact:** The `test_viewer@ghg-test.com` account was created with role `user` (fallback). It does **not** have a separate read-only "viewer" role because no such role exists.
- **Root cause:** [`auth.py` line 978](file:///c:/Users/samsung/Desktop/H2/new/server/routes/auth.py#L978-L984) — `ROLE_RANK` only includes 6 roles; `viewer` is absent.

---

### Additional Observations (Non-Bug)

- **API note:** `POST /api/auth/register` is gated by `it_admin_required` (not `admin`). An `admin` user **cannot** register new accounts via API — only `it_admin` / `it_manager` can. Accounts were seeded via direct DB insertion instead.
- **CSRF token:** Available at `GET /api/csrf-token` (returns `{"csrf_token": "..."}` and also sets it as a cookie)
- **Login endpoint:** `POST /api/auth/login` is CSRF-exempt and rate-limited (20 per 15 min)
